cmd:object.repeat.release.desc: Release the selected repeats back to their source art.

cmd:object.resetBoundingBox.label: Reset Bounding Box
cmd:object.resetBoundingBox.params: {} square the bounding box of the selected objects to the page again after a rotation (their geometry stays; one undo step, none when no box is rotated) → {changed: objects reset}
cmd:object.resetBoundingBox.desc: Square a rotated object's bounding box back to the page without changing its art.

cmd:object.rotate.label: Rotate…
cmd:object.rotate.params: {angle: deg (counter-clockwise), absolute?: bool (angle is the bounding box's new angle, not an amount), origin?: [x,y] (default: the bounding box centre), copy?, patterns?: bool (Transform Patterns: pattern fills and strokes transform with the art; default: prefs transformPatternTiles)} → {ids}
cmd:object.rotate.desc: Rotate the selection by an angle around an origin, optionally as a copy.

cmd:object.scale.label: Scale…
cmd:object.scale.params: {sx: %, sy?: %, origin?: [x,y], copy?, strokes?: bool (Scale Strokes & Effects: stroke weights, dashes and effect distances scale; off keeps them, type strokes included), corners?: bool (Scale Corners: live corner radii scale), patterns?: bool (Transform Patterns: pattern fills and strokes transform with the art; default: prefs transformPatternTiles)} (strokes/corners default to the preferences)
cmd:object.scale.desc: Resize the selection with options to scale strokes, corners and patterns.

cmd:object.setBounds.label: Set Bounds
cmd:object.setBounds.params: {x?, y?, width?, height?, reference?: 0..8 (9-point grid), proportional?, strokes?, corners?} (Transform panel; width/height and the reference point follow the bounding box, rotated with rotated objects; x, y are page coordinates; with Use Preview Bounds the values measure the visual bounds; strokes/corners as object.scale)
cmd:object.setBounds.desc: Set exact position and size of the selection from a nine-point reference.

cmd:object.setLiveShape.label: Live Shape Properties
cmd:object.setLiveShape.params: {id?, ids?, radius?: pt, kind?: "round"|"invertedRound"|"chamfer", corners?: [0..3…], sides?: n} (Live Corners: radius and kind set a rectangle's corners: `corners` (0 top-left, 1 top-right, 2 bottom-right, 3 bottom-left), else the corners with a Direct-Selected anchor, else all four; sides: a polygon's)
cmd:object.setLiveShape.desc: Set a live rectangle's corner radii, corner kinds and side counts.

cmd:object.setOverprint.label: Overprint
cmd:object.setOverprint.params: {fill?: bool, stroke?: bool, item?: appearance item index|null, ids?} make fills and/or strokes overprint (Overprint Preview, Separations Preview) or knock out: item's, else every fill or stroke of the painted objects (groups: their contents; type: its characters too). Without item and ids, the Appearance panel's active item stands in when it is of that kind → {changed: objects}
cmd:object.setOverprint.desc: Make the fills or strokes of the selection overprint or knock out.

cmd:object.setProps.label: Object Properties
cmd:object.setProps.params: {ids?|id?, name?, visible?, locked?, opacity?: 0..100, blend?: "Multiply"…, isolate?, knockout?: "on"|"off"|"neutral"|bool (true = on, false = neutral), knockoutShape?: bool}
cmd:object.setProps.desc: Rename objects or change their visibility, lock, opacity, blend mode or isolation.

cmd:object.shape.convertToShape.label: Convert to Shape
cmd:object.shape.convertToShape.params: {} turn paths that are rectangles (any rotation) or axis-aligned ellipses into live shapes → {converted}
cmd:object.shape.convertToShape.desc: Turn rectangles and ellipses that are drawn as paths back into live shapes.

cmd:object.shear.label: Shear…
cmd:object.shear.params: {angle: deg, axis?: "horizontal"|"vertical", origin?, copy?, patterns?: bool (Transform Patterns: pattern fills and strokes transform with the art; default: prefs transformPatternTiles)}
cmd:object.shear.desc: Slant the selection by an angle along a horizontal or vertical axis.

cmd:object.showAll.label: Show All
cmd:object.showAll.desc: Show all objects hidden with the hide command.

cmd:object.textWrap.make.label: Make
cmd:object.textWrap.make.params: {offset?: pt (6), invert?: bool, ids?} area type below the selected objects (same layer) wraps around them → {ids}
cmd:object.textWrap.make.desc: Make area text wrap around the selected objects.

cmd:object.textWrap.options.label: Text Wrap Options…
cmd:object.textWrap.options.params: {offset?: pt, invert?: bool, ids?} set the options of the selected wrap objects; no options → the current {offset, invert}
cmd:object.textWrap.options.desc: Set the offset or inversion of the selected text wraps.

cmd:object.textWrap.release.label: Release
cmd:object.textWrap.release.desc: Release text wraps so text flows normally.

cmd:object.transform.label: Transform
cmd:object.transform.params: {matrix: [a,b,c,d,e,f], copy?: bool, ids?, strokes?: bool, corners?: bool, typeAreas?: bool, patterns?: bool (Transform Patterns: pattern fills and strokes transform with the art; default: prefs transformPatternTiles)} apply an affine to the selection (or ids); strokes/corners: Scale Strokes & Effects / Scale Corners (default: the preferences); typeAreas: area type among them (not type inside a group) reshapes its frame by the matrix and its text reflows at its size, as a bounding-box handle drag does (default: the type transforms too)
cmd:object.transform.desc: Apply an affine transformation matrix to the selection.

cmd:object.transformAgain.label: Transform Again
cmd:object.transformAgain.desc: Repeat the last transformation on the selection.

cmd:object.transformEach.label: Transform Each…
cmd:object.transformEach.params: {scaleH?: % (100), scaleV?: % (100), moveH?: pt, moveV?: pt (down = +), rotate?: deg (counter-clockwise), reflectX?: bool (flip vertically), reflectY?: bool (flip horizontally), random?: bool, seed?: n, reference?: 0..8 (9-point grid, 4 = centre), copy?: bool, strokes?: bool (Scale Strokes & Effects), corners?: bool (Scale Corners; both default to the preferences), patterns?: bool (Transform Patterns; default: prefs transformPatternTiles)} transform every selected object about its own reference point → {ids}
cmd:object.transformEach.desc: Transform each selected object around its own reference point, with random option.

cmd:object.unlockAll.label: Unlock All
cmd:object.unlockAll.desc: Unlock every locked object in the document.

cmd:paint.complement.label: Complement
cmd:paint.complement.params: {stroke?: bool (default: the active proxy), ids?} replace the active proxy's colours by their complements ((highest + lowest) − each component, over RGB or CMY; grey unchanged) keeping each colour's model; honours the Appearance panel's active item as paint.invert does; with nothing selected, the default → {changed}
cmd:paint.complement.desc: Replace the active fill or stroke colours by their complements.

cmd:paint.default.label: Default Fill and Stroke
cmd:paint.default.params: {ids?} white fill and 1 pt black stroke for the selection and the defaults; type gets black fill and no stroke
cmd:paint.default.desc: Reset to the default white fill and black stroke.

cmd:paint.editGradient.label: Gradient
cmd:paint.editGradient.params: {stroke?: bool (default: the targeted item's kind, else the active proxy), kind?: linear|radial|freeform (freeform places points on each object, coloured along the stops), mode?: points|lines (freeform: how the Gradient tool adds points), stops?: [{offset 0..1, color? (needed without swatch), opacity? 0..1 (or 0..100), midpoint? 0.13..0.87, swatch?: colour swatch name (a global or spot colour or tint swatch links the stop, so swatch edits recolour it and a spot stop prints on its plate; a process colour just gives its colour), tint?: 0..100 (% of the linked swatch; default 100, or a tint swatch's own)}] (at least 2; a freeform gradient's points are recoloured along them), angle?: deg, aspect?: %, reverse?: bool, item?: fill/stroke item index|null (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item when it is of the edited kind), ids?, strokeMode?: within|along|across (strokes only: the gradient lies on the page and shows through the stroke, runs from the start of each subpath to its end, or runs from the stroke's left edge to its right all along it; with nothing selected, for the next object drawn; type characters' own strokes always paint within)} edit the gradient in place (keeps its placement); solid/none paints become the default gradient
cmd:paint.editGradient.desc: Edit a gradient's kind, stops, angle and other properties on the selection.

cmd:paint.freeform.addLine.label: Add Freeform Line
cmd:paint.freeform.addLine.params: {points: [index, …] (at least two), ids?, stroke?: bool (default: the targeted item's kind, else the active proxy), item?: fill/stroke item index|null (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item when it is of the edited kind)} join points with a smooth line through them, in order → {line}
cmd:paint.freeform.addLine.desc: Join freeform gradient colour points with a smooth line of blended colour.

cmd:paint.freeform.addPoint.label: Add Freeform Point
cmd:paint.freeform.addPoint.params: {at: [x,y] (document coordinates), color? (default: the gradient's colour there), opacity? 0..1 (or 0..100), spread? 0..1 (or 0..100 %; the radius of pure colour around the point, a fraction of half the object's larger side; default 0), line?: true (join it to the selected point: extends the line ending there, else starts one), ids?, stroke?: bool (default: the targeted item's kind, else the active proxy), item?: fill/stroke item index|null (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item when it is of the edited kind)} add a point to the freeform gradient (an unplaced one keeps its automatic points first) and select it → {index}
cmd:paint.freeform.addPoint.desc: Add a colour point to a freeform gradient at a position.

cmd:paint.freeform.deletePoint.label: Delete Freeform Point
cmd:paint.freeform.deletePoint.params: {index? (default: the selected point), ids?, stroke?: bool (default: the targeted item's kind, else the active proxy), item?: fill/stroke item index|null (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item when it is of the edited kind)} remove a point (never the last one); lines through it close up around it and lines left with one point go → {index}
cmd:paint.freeform.deletePoint.desc: Delete a point from a freeform gradient.

cmd:paint.freeform.get.label: Freeform Gradient
cmd:paint.freeform.get.params: {stroke?: bool (default: the active proxy)} the freeform gradient behind the proxy of the first selected object → {mode: points|lines, points: [{at: [x,y] (document coordinates), color, opacity, spread}], lines: [[index, …]], selected: index|null}
cmd:paint.freeform.get.desc: Read the freeform gradient applied to the first selected object.

cmd:paint.freeform.selectPoint.label: Select Freeform Point
cmd:paint.freeform.selectPoint.params: {index: point index | null to clear} select a point of the freeform gradient behind the active proxy (the first selected object's): the point the Gradient tool, the Gradient and Color panels and Delete act on → {index}
cmd:paint.freeform.selectPoint.desc: Select a point of the freeform gradient being edited.

cmd:paint.freeform.setPoint.label: Edit Freeform Point
cmd:paint.freeform.setPoint.params: {index? (default: the selected point), at?: [x,y] (document coordinates), color?, opacity? 0..1 (or 0..100), spread? 0..1 (or 0..100 %), ids?, stroke?: bool (default: the targeted item's kind, else the active proxy), item?: fill/stroke item index|null (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item when it is of the edited kind)} move or recolour a point of the freeform gradient → {index}
cmd:paint.freeform.setPoint.desc: Move a freeform gradient point or change its colour, opacity or spread.

cmd:paint.freeform.splitLine.label: Split Freeform Line
cmd:paint.freeform.splitLine.params: {line: line index, segment: the segment from the line's point `segment` to the next, t?: 0..1 along it (default 0.5), ids?, stroke?: bool (default: the targeted item's kind, else the active proxy), item?: fill/stroke item index|null (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item when it is of the edited kind)} add a point on a line there (colour, opacity and spread between the segment's ends) and select it → {index}
cmd:paint.freeform.splitLine.desc: Split a freeform gradient line into two at a point.

cmd:paint.invert.label: Invert
cmd:paint.invert.params: {stroke?: bool (default: the active proxy), ids?} invert the active proxy's colours of the selection (or ids; groups recolour their contents) keeping each colour's model, as edit.colors.invert does; the Appearance panel's active fill/stroke item (appearance.setActiveItem) is inverted instead when it is of that kind and no ids are given; with nothing selected, invert the default → {changed}
cmd:paint.invert.desc: Invert the colours of the active fill or stroke on the selection.

cmd:paint.lastColor.label: Apply Last Color
cmd:paint.lastColor.params: {stroke?: bool (default: the active proxy), ids?} apply the last solid colour used (paint.recent lastColor) to the active proxy of the selection and the default
cmd:paint.lastColor.desc: Apply the most recently used solid colour again.

cmd:paint.lastGradient.label: Apply Last Gradient
cmd:paint.lastGradient.params: {stroke?: bool (default: the active proxy), ids?} apply the last gradient used (paint.recent lastGradient), fitted to each object, to the active proxy of the selection and the default
cmd:paint.lastGradient.desc: Apply the most recently used gradient again, fitted to each object.

cmd:paint.none.label: None
cmd:paint.none.params: {} set the active proxy (fill or stroke) to None
cmd:paint.none.desc: Set the active fill or stroke to none.

cmd:paint.proxies.label: Fill and Stroke
cmd:paint.proxies.params: {} → {fill, stroke: the paints the Fill/Stroke proxies show (the Appearance panel's active item for the proxy of its kind, else the first selected object's, a group's first painted object's, type: its first run's; else the defaults for new art), fillActive, fillMixed, strokeMixed: the selected objects' (or a selected group's contents') fills (strokes) differ, shown as a "?" proxy}
cmd:paint.proxies.desc: Report the current fill and stroke paints behind the fill and stroke proxies.

cmd:paint.recent.label: Recent Colors
cmd:paint.recent.params: {} → {colors: [{hex, color}] newest first (fed by every paint command and the eyedropper), lastColor: {hex, color}, lastGradient: gradient paint}
cmd:paint.recent.desc: List the recently used colours, last colour and last gradient.

cmd:paint.sampleColor.label: Sample Color
cmd:paint.sampleColor.params: {color, stroke?: bool (default: whichever proxy is active), ids?, stop?: index} sample a colour into the active fill/stroke (and the selection); with `stop`, recolour that stop of the gradient behind the proxy instead (paint.editGradient)
cmd:paint.sampleColor.desc: Sample a colour into the active fill or stroke, or into a gradient stop.

cmd:paint.setFill.label: Fill
cmd:paint.setFill.params: {color?: "#rrggbb"|[r,g,b]|{c,m,y,k}|{gray}|{l,a,b} (CIE Lab), none?: true, swatch?: name (a global or spot colour stays linked, so swatch edits recolour it; a tint swatch links to its base at its tint; a gradient swatch is recorded as the gradient's swatch and fits each object, keeping its aspect; the built-in "[Registration]" prints on every plate), tint?: 0..100 (% of a global or spot `swatch`; default 100, or a tint swatch's own), gradient?: {kind?: linear|radial|freeform, stops?: [{offset 0..1, color, opacity? 0..1 (or 0..100), midpoint? 0.13..0.87, swatch?: global or spot colour (or tint) swatch the stop links to (its colour comes from the swatch), tint?: 0..100}] (at least 2; default white→black), angle?: deg, start?: [x,y], end?: [x,y] (the vector in document coordinates, both or neither; type objects keep it in text space), aspect?: % (radial; without start/end the gradient is placed on each object's bounds), focal?: [x,y] (radial, with start/end: the focal point, where the first stop sits), swatch?: linked gradient swatch name}, item?: appearance item index|null (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item if it is a fill, else the top fill), ids?, focus?: true (false keeps the active proxy), keepModel?: false (in a CMYK document, RGB colours and gradient stops are stored as CMYK unless true; Gray stays Gray)} sets the selection's fill and the default (new art fits a gradient to itself)
cmd:paint.setFill.desc: Set the fill colour, swatch, gradient or none of the selection or defaults.

cmd:paint.setGradientGeom.label: Gradient Vector
cmd:paint.setGradientGeom.params: {start?: [x,y], end?: [x,y] (document coordinates; both or neither: omitted, the vector stays), aspect?: % (radial: the extent ellipse's height / width; default: kept), focal?: [x,y] (document coordinates) | null (radial: the focal point, where the first stop sits, pulled inside the extent ellipse; null centres it; default: it keeps its place in the ellipse), ids?, stroke?: bool (default: the targeted item's kind, else the active proxy), item?: fill/stroke item index|null (alias: index; omitted: the Appearance panel's active item when it is of the edited kind)} set the gradient vector, aspect ratio and focal point (solid paints become the default gradient; type objects set it on their runs, in text space)
cmd:paint.setGradientGeom.desc: Set a gradient's start and end points, aspect or focal point.

cmd:paint.setStroke.label: Stroke
cmd:paint.setStroke.params: same as paint.setFill, for the stroke (item?: the stroke item to set)
cmd:paint.setStroke.desc: Set the stroke colour, swatch, gradient or none of the selection or defaults.

cmd:paint.swap.label: Swap Fill and Stroke
cmd:paint.swap.params: {ids?} swap the fill and stroke of the selection (type too) and of the defaults
cmd:paint.swap.desc: Swap the fill and stroke of the selection.

cmd:paint.toggleActive.label: Toggle Fill/Stroke Focus
cmd:paint.toggleActive.params: {fill?: bool (true: bring the Fill proxy forward, false: the Stroke proxy; omitted: swap which is in front)} → {fillActive}
cmd:paint.toggleActive.desc: Bring the fill or stroke proxy forward as the active one.

cmd:paraStyle.apply.label: Apply Paragraph Style
cmd:paraStyle.apply.params: {name, clearOverrides?, ids?|id + start?/end? (a Type tool range)} → {count}
cmd:paraStyle.apply.desc: Apply a paragraph style to text, optionally clearing overrides.

cmd:paraStyle.delete.label: Delete Paragraph Style
cmd:paraStyle.delete.desc: Delete a paragraph style; the text keeps its look.

cmd:paraStyle.duplicate.label: Duplicate Paragraph Style
cmd:paraStyle.duplicate.desc: Duplicate a paragraph style under a new name.

cmd:paraStyle.list.label: Paragraph Styles
cmd:paraStyle.list.desc: List all paragraph styles with their attributes and use counts.

cmd:paraStyle.new.label: New Paragraph Style
cmd:paraStyle.new.desc: Create a paragraph style, by default from the selected text's formatting.

cmd:paraStyle.redefine.label: Redefine Paragraph Style
cmd:paraStyle.redefine.params: {name, id?, start?} from the selected text; users keep their overrides
cmd:paraStyle.redefine.desc: Redefine a paragraph style from the selected text's formatting.

cmd:paraStyle.setAttrs.label: Paragraph Style Options
cmd:paraStyle.setAttrs.params: {name, attrs: {…}} replace the style's attributes; users keep their overrides
cmd:paraStyle.setAttrs.desc: Replace a paragraph style's attributes in its options.

cmd:path.appendAnchor.label: Add Anchor (Pen)
cmd:path.appendAnchor.params: {id, x, y, in?: [x,y], out?: [x,y]} append to the end of the last open subpath
cmd:path.appendAnchor.desc: Append an anchor to the end of the last open subpath.

cmd:path.average.label: Average…
cmd:path.average.desc: Pull selected anchor points together on a horizontal, vertical or both axes.

cmd:path.blob.label: Blob Brush
cmd:path.blob.params: {points: [[x,y]…], size?: pt (10), merge?: true} filled brush shape, merged with touching same-colour blobs → {id}
cmd:path.blob.desc: Paint a filled blob stroke that merges with same-colour blobs.

cmd:path.close.label: Close Path
cmd:path.close.params: {id, in?: [x,y] (handle into the first anchor), independent?: bool}
cmd:path.close.desc: Close an open path, joining its endpoints.

cmd:path.convertAnchor.label: Convert Anchor Point
cmd:path.convertAnchor.params: {id, subpath, anchor, to: "corner"|"smooth", x?, y?} (smooth with x/y: out handle there, in handle mirrored)
cmd:path.convertAnchor.desc: Convert an anchor point between corner and smooth.

cmd:path.convertAnchors.label: Convert Anchor Points
cmd:path.convertAnchors.params: {to: "corner"|"smooth"} convert the direct-selected anchors (all anchors of fully selected paths) as one undo step: corner retracts both handles, smooth pulls handles in line with the neighbours (smooth anchors keep theirs)
cmd:path.convertAnchors.desc: Convert selected anchors between smooth curves and sharp corners.

cmd:path.create.label: Create Path
cmd:path.create.params: {anchors: [{x, y, in?: [x,y], out?: [x,y]}], closed?: bool, d?: SVG path data} → {id}
cmd:path.create.desc: Create a path from anchor coordinates or svg path data.

cmd:path.curvature.label: Curvature
cmd:path.curvature.params: {points: [{x, y, corner?}], closed?, id?} create (or with id: replace) a path curving through the points → {id}
cmd:path.curvature.desc: Create or replace a path curving smoothly through given points.

cmd:path.cutAtAnchors.label: Cut Path at Selected Anchor Points
cmd:path.cutAtAnchors.params: {} cut the paths at their direct-selected anchors (one undo step): a closed path opens there, an open one becomes one path per piece; one of each cut's two coincident anchors stays selected → {ids}
cmd:path.cutAtAnchors.desc: Cut paths open at the selected anchors, splitting shapes there.

cmd:path.deleteAnchors.label: Delete Anchor Points
cmd:path.deleteAnchors.params: {} delete the direct-selected anchors and their segments, opening closed paths there (the Delete key)
cmd:path.deleteAnchors.desc: Delete selected anchors and their segments, opening closed paths.

cmd:path.eraseRegion.label: Eraser
cmd:path.eraseRegion.params: {points: [[x,y]…], size?: pt (10)} erase a round-brush stroke from paths (selected, or all) → {ids}
cmd:path.eraseRegion.desc: Erase part of paths with a round eraser brush stroke.

cmd:path.eraseSegments.label: Path Eraser
cmd:path.eraseSegments.params: {points: [[x,y]…], width?: pt (8)} erase the parts of selected paths under the drag → {ids}
cmd:path.eraseSegments.desc: Erase the parts of selected paths under the drag.

cmd:path.freehand.label: Pencil
cmd:path.freehand.params: {points: [[x,y]…], fidelity?: pt (1.5), closed?, style?: "pencil"|"brush", fill?: bool, extend?: {id, end: "start"|"end"}} fit a freehand stroke → {id}
cmd:path.freehand.desc: Fit a freehand pencil stroke through drawn points.

cmd:path.insertAnchor.label: Add Anchor Point
cmd:path.insertAnchor.desc: Insert an anchor point into a segment of a path.

cmd:path.join.label: Join
cmd:path.join.params: {} join two open paths' nearest endpoints, or close a single open path
cmd:path.join.desc: Join two open paths at their nearest endpoints, or close one open path.

cmd:path.joinScrub.label: Join
cmd:path.joinScrub.params: {points: [[x,y]…], tolerance?: pt (12)} join the open-path endpoints scrubbed over → {id}
cmd:path.joinScrub.desc: Join the open endpoints scrubbed over with the pointer.

cmd:path.knife.label: Knife
cmd:path.knife.params: {points: [[x,y]…]} cut closed shapes (selected, or all when nothing is selected) along the polyline → {ids}
cmd:path.knife.desc: Cut closed shapes along a freehand polyline.

cmd:path.moveAnchors.label: Move Anchors
cmd:path.moveAnchors.params: {dx, dy} move direct-selected anchors (whole paths if fully selected)
cmd:path.moveAnchors.desc: Move the directly selected anchor points by an offset.

cmd:path.removeAnchor.label: Delete Anchor Point
cmd:path.removeAnchor.params: {id, subpath, anchor} remove one anchor, re-fitting the curve
cmd:path.removeAnchor.desc: Remove one anchor point, re-fitting the curve.

cmd:path.reshape.label: Reshape
cmd:path.reshape.params: {id, x, y, dx, dy, tol=3, radius?} Reshape tool: grab the path at (x, y) (adding an anchor there unless one is within tol) and drag it by (dx, dy); nearby anchors follow with a smooth falloff over radius (default: half the subpath's size)
cmd:path.reshape.desc: Drag the path at a point, pulling nearby anchors smoothly with the reshape tool.

cmd:path.reshapeSegment.label: Reshape Segment
cmd:path.reshapeSegment.params: {id, subpath, segment, t, dx, dy} bend a segment so the point at t moves by (dx, dy)
cmd:path.reshapeSegment.desc: Bend a path segment so a point on it moves by an offset.

cmd:path.reverse.label: Reverse Path Direction
cmd:path.reverse.params: {ids?, reversed?: bool (true: every subpath runs counter-clockwise on screen, false: clockwise, the Attributes panel's Reverse Path Direction On / Off; omitted: flip each path)} the paths in ids or the selection (groups and compound paths: the paths inside), as one undo step → {changed: paths}
cmd:path.reverse.desc: Reverse the direction of paths, or set subpaths consistently clockwise or counter-clockwise.

cmd:path.setAnchors.label: Set Anchors
cmd:path.setAnchors.params: {id, subpaths: [{anchors: [{x,y,in?,out?}], closed}]} replace a path's geometry
cmd:path.setAnchors.desc: Replace a path's whole geometry with new subpaths and anchors.

cmd:path.setFillRule.label: Fill Rule
cmd:path.setFillRule.params: {rule: "nonZero"|"evenOdd", ids?} the fill rule of the paths and compound paths in ids or the selection (groups: those inside), as one undo step → {changed}
cmd:path.setFillRule.desc: Set the fill rule of paths to nonzero or even-odd.

cmd:path.setHandle.label: Move Direction Handle
cmd:path.setHandle.params: {id, subpath, anchor, which: "in"|"out", x, y, independent?: bool}
cmd:path.setHandle.desc: Move a direction handle of an anchor point.

cmd:path.smoothRegion.label: Smooth
cmd:path.smoothRegion.params: {points: [[x,y]…], radius?: pt (12), fidelity?: pt (2.5)} smooth selected paths near the drag → {ids, before, after}
cmd:path.smoothRegion.desc: Smooth the selected paths near a dragged stroke.

cmd:path.split.label: Split Path
cmd:path.split.params: {id, subpath, segment, t} or {id, subpath, anchor}: closed paths open there, open paths become two → {ids}
cmd:path.split.desc: Open a closed path or split an open path at a point.

cmd:pattern.delete.label: Delete Pattern
cmd:pattern.delete.params: {name} delete a pattern swatch (objects painted with it lose that paint)
cmd:pattern.delete.desc: Delete a pattern swatch; objects painted with it lose that paint.

cmd:pattern.list.label: List Patterns
cmd:pattern.list.desc: List the document's pattern swatches with their tile settings.

cmd:pattern.options.label: Pattern Options
cmd:pattern.options.params: {name? (default: the pattern being edited), newName?, tileType?, brickOffset?, width?, height?, hSpacing?, vSpacing?, sizeTileToArt?: bool, overlap?: {h: left|right, v: top|bottom}, copies?: 3|5|7|9, dimCopies?: %, showTileEdge?: bool, showSwatchBounds?: bool (outline the part of the tiling the swatch repeats, dashed)}
cmd:pattern.options.desc: Change pattern tile type, size, spacing and overlap options.

cmd:pattern.transform.label: Transform Patterns
cmd:pattern.transform.params: {ids?, matrix: [a,b,c,d,e,f]} transform only the pattern placement of the objects' pattern paints (Transform Patterns)
cmd:pattern.transform.desc: Transform only the pattern placement of the objects' pattern paints.

cmd:perspective.attach.label: Attach to Active Plane
cmd:perspective.attach.params: {ids?, plane?: left|right|ground (default: the active plane)} project the objects onto the plane
cmd:perspective.attach.desc: Project the selected objects onto a perspective grid plane.

cmd:perspective.draw.label: Draw in Perspective
cmd:perspective.draw.params: {command: shape.* id, params, plane?, snap?: bool (default: Snap to Grid)} run a shape command and attach the result to the plane (snapping its corners to gridlines within a quarter cell)
cmd:perspective.draw.desc: Run a shape command and attach the result to a perspective plane.

cmd:perspective.grid.preset.label: Perspective Grid Preset

cmd:stroke.set.params: {weight?: pt, cap?: butt|round|square, join?: miter|round|bevel, miterLimit?, align?: center|inside|outside, dash?: [d,g,…]|null (a 0 dash with a round or projecting cap draws dots or squares; a new pattern keeps the current offset and alignment), dashOffset? cmd:stroke.setAdvanced.label: Stroke Options

cmd:swatch.list.label: Swatches
cmd:swatch.list.params: {group?: name (only that colour group's swatches)} → {swatches: [{name, kind: "none"|"color"|"gradient"|"pattern", group, global, spot, color?, hex?, tintOf?: base swatch of a tint swatch, tint?: its %, gradient?, pattern?}] (the built-in [Registration] after None: it prints on every plate and can't be edited, moved or deleted), groups: [{name, swatches: [names]}]}
cmd:swatch.list.desc: List the document's swatches and colour groups with their colours.

cmd:swatch.merge.label: Merge Swatches
cmd:swatch.merge.params: {names: [two or more solid-colour swatches]} keep the first (its name and colour) and delete the others; paints linked to them take its colour and link to it (or unlink when it isn't global), as one undo step → {name, merged: [deleted names], relinked}
cmd:swatch.merge.desc: Merge solid-colour swatches into one, relinking paints that used them.

cmd:swatch.move.label: Move Swatch
cmd:swatch.move.params: {name? | names?: [swatch names, in order; or colour group names to reorder the groups], to?: index in the destination (they go before the swatch or group now there; default: the end), group?: destination colour group (default: the ungrouped swatches; groups hold solid colours only)} reorder swatches or move them into or out of colour groups, as one undo step → {moved}
cmd:swatch.move.desc: Move swatches or colour groups to another position or group in the panel.

cmd:swatch.new.label: New Swatch
cmd:swatch.new.params: {name?, color? | colors?: [colour] (one swatch each, in one undo step) | swatch? | gradient? | pattern?: name (default: the current fill), tint?: 0..100 (% of the global or spot `swatch`, or of the one the current fill links to), mode?: "gray"|"rgb"|"hsb"|"lab"|"cmyk"|"web" (convert the colour; lab: CIE L*a*b*, how spot colours are usually defined), global?, spot? (a spot colour, always global), group?: colour group name (solid colours only; default: ungrouped)} save a colour, gradient or pattern as a swatch. A tint of a global or spot colour (below 100%, without mode, global or spot) becomes a tint swatch, "Name 40%", linked to its base: it follows edits to the base and applies as that tint of it. Names are unique ("Sky 2"); a colour's default name is its values ("C=10 M=20 Y=30 K=0", "R=255 G=128 B=0", "Gray K=40", "L=55 a=60 b=40") → {name, names: [every new swatch]}
cmd:swatch.new.desc: Create colour, gradient, pattern or tint swatches, by default from the current fill.

cmd:swatch.newGroup.label: New Color Group
cmd:swatch.newGroup.params: {name?, swatches?: [names] (solid colours move into the group; gradients, patterns and None stay), colors?: [colour] (added as new swatches), fromArtwork?: false (add the unique colours of the selected art: fills, strokes, text, gradient stops and mesh points; a colour linked to a global swatch moves that swatch into the group), toGlobal?: true (with fromArtwork: the new swatches are global and the selected art's matching unlinked colours link to them), includeTints?: false (with fromArtwork: tints of global swatches also get swatches of their own)} → {name, swatches: [names in the group], linked: paints linked}
cmd:swatch.newGroup.desc: Create a colour group from swatches, colours or the artwork's colours.

cmd:swatch.resetDefaults.label: Default Swatches
cmd:swatch.resetDefaults.params: {replace?: false} bring back the default swatches and colour groups of the document's colour mode that are missing (by name), as one undo step; replace: true makes the swatches exactly the defaults (art linked to a removed global swatch keeps its colour, unlinked) → {added: [names]}
cmd:swatch.resetDefaults.desc: Restore missing default swatches and colour groups, or replace all with defaults.

cmd:swatch.setSpot.label: Spot Color
cmd:swatch.setSpot.params: {name, spot?: true} make a swatch a spot colour (prints on its own plate; spot swatches are global) → {name, spot}
cmd:swatch.setSpot.desc: Make a swatch a spot colour that prints on its own plate.

cmd:swatch.sortByKind.label: Sort by Kind
cmd:swatch.sortByKind.params: {} order the swatches of each list by kind (None first, then process colours, spot colours, gradients, patterns; colour groups stay after them), keeping their order within a kind, as one undo step
cmd:swatch.sortByKind.desc: Order swatches by kind: none, colours, spot colours, gradients then patterns.

cmd:swatch.spotOptions.label: Spot Colors
cmd:swatch.spotOptions.params: {useLab?: bool (omitted: unchanged)} the document's Spot Colors options: spot colours defined in Lab show, print and export from their Lab values (true, the default: PDF Separation spaces get a Lab alternate) or from their working-CMYK equivalents (false: a DeviceCMYK alternate, matching older files). Art, gradient stops and tint swatches linked to Lab spot swatches take the chosen colour at their tint, as one undo step → {useLab, relinked: paints changed}
cmd:swatch.spotOptions.desc: Set whether spot colours separate from their lab values or cmyk equivalents.

cmd:swatch.ungroup.label: Ungroup Color Group
cmd:swatch.ungroup.params: {name: colour group} move its swatches to the end of the ungrouped swatches and remove the group, as one undo step → {swatches: [names]}
cmd:swatch.ungroup.desc: Ungroup a colour group, moving its swatches to the ungrouped list.

cmd:swatch.unused.label: Select All Unused
cmd:swatch.unused.params: {} → {names: [the swatches nothing uses, in panel order]}: a colour is used when a paint links to it or an unlinked paint, gradient stop or mesh point has its colour; a gradient when a gradient links to it or has its stops; a pattern when it fills or strokes anything (art, symbols, pattern tiles and graphic styles count). None is never listed
cmd:swatch.unused.desc: Find the swatches nothing in the document uses.

cmd:symbol.adjust.label: Symbolism Tool
cmd:symbol.adjust.params: {tool: shift|scrunch|size|spin|stain|screen|style, points: [[x,y]…], radius?: 40, intensity?: 1..10 (5), alt?: bool, color?, style?: name} adjust instances near the points (selection, else all) → {count}
cmd:symbol.adjust.desc: Adjust symbol instances near the strokes of the symbolism tools.

cmd:symbol.breakLink.label: Break Link to Symbol
cmd:symbol.breakLink.params: {ids?} expand selected instances into plain art → {ids}
cmd:symbol.breakLink.desc: Break the link of symbol instances so they become plain editable art.

cmd:symbol.delete.label: Delete Symbol
cmd:symbol.delete.params: {name, expandInstances?: true} delete a symbol; its instances are expanded (or deleted with false)
cmd:symbol.delete.desc: Delete a symbol, expanding or deleting its instances.

cmd:symbol.duplicate.label: Duplicate Symbol
cmd:symbol.duplicate.desc: Duplicate a symbol under a new name.

cmd:symbol.edit.label: Edit Symbol
cmd:symbol.edit.params: {id?} break the link of the selected instance so its art can be edited; finish with symbol.update → {name, ids}
cmd:symbol.edit.desc: Break an instance's link so its art can be edited, then update the symbol.

cmd:symbol.list.label: Symbols
cmd:symbol.list.desc: List the document's symbols with instance counts and sizes.

cmd:symbol.new.label: New Symbol…
cmd:symbol.new.params: {name?, ids?} make a symbol from the selection and replace it with an instance → {name, id}
cmd:symbol.new.desc: Make a symbol from the selection, replacing it with an instance.

cmd:symbol.place.label: Place Symbol Instance
cmd:symbol.place.params: {name?, x?, y?} place an instance centred at (x, y) (default: artboard centre; name default: current) → {id}
cmd:symbol.place.desc: Place an instance of a symbol at a position.

cmd:symbol.replace.label: Replace Symbol
cmd:symbol.replace.params: {name, ids?} swap the symbol of the selected instances → {ids}
cmd:symbol.replace.desc: Swap the symbol of the selected instances to another symbol.

cmd:symbol.selectInstances.label: Select All Instances
cmd:symbol.selectInstances.params: {name} select every instance of a symbol → {count}
cmd:symbol.selectInstances.desc: Select every instance of a symbol in the document.

cmd:symbol.setCurrent.label: Current Symbol
cmd:symbol.setCurrent.params: {name} the symbol the symbolism tools spray (not an undo step)
cmd:symbol.setCurrent.desc: Choose the symbol the symbol sprayer sprays.

cmd:symbol.spray.label: Symbol Sprayer
cmd:symbol.spray.params: {points: [[x,y]…], name?, radius?: 40, density?: 1..10 (5), scale?: 1, alt?: bool (remove instances)} spray instances into a symbol set → {id, count}
cmd:symbol.spray.desc: Spray symbol instances onto the canvas with the symbol sprayer.

cmd:symbol.update.label: Redefine Symbol
cmd:symbol.update.params: {name, ids?} replace the symbol's art with the selection (instances update; the selection becomes an instance) → {name, id}
cmd:symbol.update.desc: Replace a symbol's art with the selection so all instances update.

cmd:text.areaOptions.label: Area Type Options…
cmd:text.areaOptions.params: {ids?, width?: pt, height?: pt, rows?, columns?, gutter?: pt, inset?: pt, firstBaseline?: ascent|capHeight|xHeight|leading|fixed, firstBaselineMin?: pt} set the selected area type's options; width and height size the type area from its top-left corner, along the type's own axes, and the text reflows at its size (none given: query) → the first object's options
cmd:text.areaOptions.desc: Set an area text frame's size, rows, columns, gutter and inset.

cmd:text.create.label: Create Text
cmd:text.create.params: {x, y, text, vertical?: bool = false, size?: pt, font?: family, style?, color?, area?: {width, height}, placeholder?: bool (fill it with placeholder text instead, as the Type tools do with prefs placeholderText)} → {id}
cmd:text.create.desc: Create a text object at a point with font, size, colour and content.

cmd:text.createInPath.label: Area / Path Type
cmd:text.createInPath.params: {path: id, mode: "area"|"onPath", text?: "", vertical?: bool = false, at?: [x, y] (on-path start: nearest point), size?, font?, placeholder?: bool (placeholder text instead, as text.create)} turn a path into an area-type frame or a type-on-a-path baseline (the path's paint is dropped) → {id}
cmd:text.createInPath.desc: Turn a path into a type area or a baseline for type on a path.

cmd:text.editRange.label: Edit Text
cmd:text.editRange.params: {id, start: byte, end: byte, insert?: string, runs?: [{text, style}]} replace bytes start..end of the plain text (inserted text takes the replaced text's style unless styled `runs` are given) → {id, caret}
cmd:text.editRange.desc: Edit part of a text object's content by byte range.

cmd:text.fitHeadline.label: Fit Headline
cmd:text.fitHeadline.params: {ids?} track the first line of area type so it fills the frame width → {tracking}
cmd:text.fitHeadline.desc: Track the first line of area type so it fills the frame width.

cmd:text.fonts.label: Fonts in Document
cmd:text.fonts.params: {selectionOnly?} → [{family, style, runs, objects, missing, status: exact|substitute|missing, resolved: {family, style}, missingGlyphs}] sorted by name. A font is found by any of its names (ヒラギノ角ゴシック = Hiragino Sans) among the loaded and installed fonts; substitute: the family is there but not the style (resolved names the stand-in); missing: the family is unknown (the fallback family stands in); missingGlyphs: characters of its text the resolved font lacks (drawn by a fallback font)
cmd:text.fonts.desc: List the fonts the document uses with substitution and missing-glyph status.

cmd:text.getRange.label: Get Text Range
cmd:text.getRange.desc: Read the text and style runs of a byte range.

cmd:text.replaceFont.label: Replace Font
cmd:text.replaceFont.params: {from: {family, style?}, to: {family (any of its names; stored as the font's own family name), style?}, selectionOnly?} (style omitted: every style of the family / keep the closest style) → {runs}
cmd:text.replaceFont.desc: Replace one font with another throughout the document or selection.

cmd:text.setFormat.label: Character / Paragraph
cmd:text.setFormat.params: {ids?|id?, kerning?: 1/1000 em|"auto", baselineShift?: pt, hScale?: %, vScale?: %, rotation?: deg, underline?, strikethrough?, allCaps?, smallCaps?: bool, position?: "normal"|"superscript"|"subscript" (sizes from Document Setup), leftIndent?, rightIndent?, firstLineIndent?, spaceBefore?, spaceAfter?: pt, hyphenate?: bool, mojikumi?: "none"|"lineEndHalf" (Japanese punctuation spacing), direction?: "auto"|"leftToRight"|"rightToLeft" (paragraph direction; auto: from each paragraph's first strong character), leadingModel?: "romanBaseline"|"emBoxTop" (leading measured baseline to baseline, or em box top to top), charAlign?: "romanBaseline"|"emBoxTop"|"emBoxCenter"|"emBoxBottom" (where characters smaller than the largest on their line line up with it), burasagari?: "none"|"standard"|"forced" (Paragraph panel menu › Burasagari None/Regular/Force: an East Asian comma or full stop ending an area type line hangs outside it: when it doesn't fit, or always; new type: "standard")}
cmd:text.setFormat.desc: Set character and paragraph formatting: kerning, case, indents, spacing and more.

cmd:text.setRangeStyle.label: Character
cmd:text.setRangeStyle.params: {id, start?: byte, end?: byte (default: all text), font?, style?, size?: pt, leading?: pt|"auto", tracking?, kerning?: 1/1000 em|"auto", baselineShift?: pt, hScale?: %, vScale?: %, rotation?: deg, fill?: colour|"none", stroke?: colour|"none", strokeWidth?: pt, strokeOptions?: {weight?, cap?, join?, miterLimit?, dash?, dashOffset?, alignDashes?} (as stroke.set: the character stroke), underline?, strikethrough?, allCaps?: bool, smallCaps?: bool, position?: "normal"|"superscript"|"subscript" (sizes from Document Setup), features?: ["dlig", "-liga", …], charAlign?: "romanBaseline"|"emBoxTop"|"emBoxCenter"|"emBoxBottom"} style a character range (runs are split at the range ends) → {id, runs}
cmd:text.setRangeStyle.desc: Style a byte range of a text object: font, size, colour and more.

cmd:text.setStyle.label: Character
cmd:text.setStyle.params: {ids?|id?, font?, style?, size?: pt, leading?: pt|"auto", tracking?: 1/1000 em, justify?: "auto" (the start of each paragraph's direction)|"left"|"center"|"right"|"justifyAll", fill?: colour, features?: ["dlig", "-liga", …] OpenType}
cmd:text.setStyle.desc: Set font, size, leading, justification and colour for whole text objects.

cmd:text.setText.label: Set Text
cmd:text.setText.params: {id?|ids?, text} replace the contents of text objects (keeps the first run's style)
cmd:text.setText.desc: Replace the contents of text objects, keeping the first run's style.

cmd:text.tabs.clear.label: Clear All Tabs
cmd:text.tabs.clear.desc: Clear all tab stops of the selected text.

cmd:text.tabs.get.label: Tab Stops
cmd:text.tabs.get.params: {ids?} → {stops} of the first selected text object
cmd:text.tabs.get.desc: Read the tab stops of the first selected text object.

cmd:text.tabs.set.label: Set Tab Stops
cmd:text.tabs.set.params: {stops: [{position: pt, align?: left|center|right|decimal, leader?: ". ", alignOn?: "."}], ids?} replace the tab stops of the selected text
cmd:text.tabs.set.desc: Set the tab stops of the selected text with alignment and leaders.

cmd:text.thread.create.label: Create
cmd:text.thread.create.params: {} thread the selected area type (and closed paths, which become frames) in stacking order → {ids}
cmd:text.thread.create.desc: Thread the selected area type frames so text flows between them.

cmd:text.thread.info.label: Threads
cmd:text.thread.info.desc: List every text thread and the frames in order.

cmd:text.thread.releaseSelection.label: Release Selection
cmd:text.thread.releaseSelection.params: {} take the selected frames out of their threads (the story re-flows through the rest)
cmd:text.thread.releaseSelection.desc: Take the selected frames out of their text threads, reflowing the story.

cmd:text.thread.remove.label: Remove Threading
cmd:text.thread.remove.params: {} break the selected frames' threads; each frame keeps the text it shows
cmd:text.thread.remove.desc: Break the selected frames' threads, each keeping its text.

cmd:tool.options.label: Tool Options…
cmd:tool.options.params: {tool: id} what double-clicking a tool button opens: hand → fits the artboard in the window (view.fitArtboard), zoom → 100% (view.actualSize), rotate|scale|reflect|shear → that Object › Transform dialog (dialog `rotate`, `scale`, `reflect` or `shear`; error `nothing selected` without a selection), selection|directSelection|groupSelection → the Move dialog (dialog `move`; the same error), gradient → the Gradient panel (window.panel), eyedropper → Eyedropper Options (dialog `eyedropperOptions`, fields sampleSize, pickUp, apply; OK runs eyedropper.setOptions), printTiling → resets the print tiling (print.tiling.set {reset: true}), warp|twirl|pucker|bloat|scallop|crystallize|wrinkle → that tool's Tool Options (dialog `liquifyOptions`, fields tool, width, height, angle, intensity %, usePressure, detail, simplify, simplifyOn, rate, complexity, horizontal %, vertical %, affectAnchors, affectIn, affectOut, showBrush; OK runs tool.setOption {tool, values}), pencil|paintbrush|smooth|blobBrush|eraser → that tool's Tool Options (dialog `freehandOptions`, fields tool and the options the tool keeps: fidelity (pt), fill, closeWithin and editWithin (px, 0 is off), size (pt); OK runs tool.setOption {tool, values})
cmd:tool.options.desc: Open the options dialog a double-click on a tool button shows.

cmd:tool.select.label: Select Tool
cmd:tool.select.desc: Make a tool the active tool.

cmd:tool.setOption.label: Tool Option
cmd:tool.setOption.params: {key, value} | {values: {key: value…}}, tool?: id (default: the active tool) → the tool's options (`{}` reads them). The options a tool keeps (Liquify brush and tool options, Mirror & Cut, Puppet Warp, drawing tools…) last across tool switches and are saved with the preferences; another tool's are stored for when it is chosen
cmd:tool.setOption.desc: Set a tool's remembered option values, like brush size or tool behaviour.

cmd:transparency.disableOpacityMask.label: Disable Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.disableOpacityMask.params: {id?|ids?} keep the mask but stop applying it
cmd:transparency.disableOpacityMask.desc: Keep an opacity mask but stop applying it.

cmd:transparency.editOpacityMask.label: Edit Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.editOpacityMask.params: {id?} edit the mask art of `id` (default: the first selected object with a mask) in place, as clicking the mask thumbnail in the Transparency panel does → {layer}
cmd:transparency.editOpacityMask.desc: Edit an opacity mask's artwork in place on the canvas.

cmd:transparency.enableOpacityMask.label: Enable Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.enableOpacityMask.desc: Re-enable an opacity mask that was disabled.

cmd:transparency.info.label: Transparency Info
cmd:transparency.info.params: {id?|ids?} → {ids, opacity: 0..100, blend, isolate, knockout: "on"|"off"|"neutral", knockoutShape, editingMask, pageIsolatedBlending, pageKnockoutGroup} the Transparency panel's values for `ids`, the selection, or the object whose mask is being edited. A value is null where those objects differ (or there are none); editingMask is the id of the object whose mask is being edited, or null; the page values are the document's
cmd:transparency.info.desc: Report the transparency panel values of objects: opacity, blend, isolation and knockout.

cmd:transparency.linkOpacityMask.label: Link Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.linkOpacityMask.desc: Link an opacity mask to its object so they move together.

cmd:transparency.makeOpacityMask.label: Make Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.makeOpacityMask.params: {ids?, clip?, invert?} the topmost of the selected objects (or of `ids`) becomes the mask of the others (grouped if several). One object gets an empty mask and enters mask editing: draw the mask, then transparency.stopEditingOpacityMask → {id, editing}
cmd:transparency.makeOpacityMask.desc: Turn the topmost selected object into an opacity mask for the others.

cmd:transparency.opacityMaskInfo.label: Opacity Mask Info
cmd:transparency.opacityMaskInfo.params: {id?|ids?} → [{id, clip, invert, disabled, linked, art}] the opacity masks of `ids`, the selection, or the object whose mask is being edited
cmd:transparency.opacityMaskInfo.desc: Report the options and state of objects' opacity masks.

cmd:transparency.releaseOpacityMask.label: Release Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.releaseOpacityMask.params: {id?|ids?} put the mask art back above each masked object (default: the selection, or the object whose mask is being edited, which leaves mask editing)
cmd:transparency.releaseOpacityMask.desc: Release an opacity mask, putting its artwork back on the canvas.

cmd:transparency.set.label: Transparency
cmd:transparency.set.params: {ids?|id?, opacity?: 0..100, blend?: name, isolate?, knockout?: "on"|"off"|"neutral"|bool (true = on, false = neutral), knockoutShape?: bool, item?: appearance item index|null} for `ids`, the selection, or the object whose opacity mask is being edited; opacity and blend go to the targeted fill/stroke item (omitted: the Appearance panel's active item, else the objects)
cmd:transparency.set.desc: Set opacity, blend mode, isolation or knockout for objects or an appearance item.

cmd:transparency.setOpacityMask.label: Opacity Mask Options
cmd:transparency.setOpacityMask.params: {id?|ids?, clip?, invert?, disabled?, linked?} change the opacity masks of `ids`, the selection, or the object whose mask is being edited
cmd:transparency.setOpacityMask.desc: Change opacity mask options: clip, invert, disabled or linked.

cmd:transparency.stopEditingOpacityMask.label: Stop Editing Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.stopEditingOpacityMask.desc: Leave opacity mask editing and return to normal editing.

cmd:transparency.toggleNewMasksClipping.label: New Opacity Masks Are Clipping
cmd:transparency.toggleNewMasksClipping.desc: Toggle whether new opacity masks are clipping masks by default.

cmd:transparency.toggleNewMasksInverted.label: New Opacity Masks Are Inverted
cmd:transparency.toggleNewMasksInverted.desc: Toggle whether new opacity masks are inverted by default.

cmd:transparency.togglePageIsolatedBlend.label: Page Isolated Blending
cmd:transparency.togglePageIsolatedBlend.params: {value?} make the page an isolated group (default: toggle): blend modes of top-level objects don't blend with what lies under the page; saved with the document and written to PDF → {value}
cmd:transparency.togglePageIsolatedBlend.desc: Toggle whether the page blends as an isolated group.

cmd:transparency.togglePageKnockoutGroup.label: Page Knockout Group
cmd:transparency.togglePageKnockoutGroup.params: {value?} make the page a knockout group (default: toggle): its layers (the contents of neutral layers) hide what they cover instead of showing it through their transparency; saved with the document and written to PDF → {value}
cmd:transparency.togglePageKnockoutGroup.desc: Toggle whether the page acts as a knockout group for its layers.

cmd:transparency.unlinkOpacityMask.label: Unlink Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.unlinkOpacityMask.params: {id?|ids?} the object moves without its mask
cmd:transparency.unlinkOpacityMask.desc: Unlink an opacity mask so the object moves without its mask.

cmd:transparency.viewOpacityMask.label: View Opacity Mask
cmd:transparency.viewOpacityMask.params: {on?: bool (default: toggle), id?} show only the opacity mask of `id` (default: the object whose mask is edited, else the first selected object with a mask) on the canvas, as greyscale coverage, and edit it, as Alt-clicking the mask thumbnail does; off shows the artwork again (still editing) → {on, id}
cmd:transparency.viewOpacityMask.desc: Show and edit an object's opacity mask alone, as greyscale coverage.

cmd:type.changeCase.label: Change Case
cmd:type.changeCase.desc: Change the case of the selected text to upper, lower, title or sentence.

cmd:type.convertToAreaType.label: Convert To Area Type
cmd:type.convertToAreaType.params: {ids?} point type → area type framed by its current layout bounds → {ids}
cmd:type.convertToAreaType.desc: Convert point type into area type inside a frame.

cmd:type.convertToPointType.label: Convert To Point Type
cmd:type.convertToPointType.params: {ids?} area type → point type; soft line wraps become line breaks → {ids}
cmd:type.convertToPointType.desc: Convert area type into point type, turning soft wraps into line breaks.

cmd:type.createOutlines.label: Create Outlines
cmd:type.createOutlines.params: {} convert the selected text to groups of compound paths (one per glyph) → {ids}
cmd:type.createOutlines.desc: Convert the selected text into compound path outlines, one per glyph.

cmd:type.fillPlaceholder.label: Fill with Placeholder Text
cmd:type.fillPlaceholder.params: {ids?} replace selected text with placeholder text (area type is filled to its frame) → {ids}
cmd:type.fillPlaceholder.desc: Fill the selected text with placeholder text.

cmd:type.findFont.label: Find Font…
cmd:type.findFont.params: {} open the Find Font dialog (engine: text.fonts / text.replaceFont / select.font)
cmd:type.findFont.desc: Open the find font dialog to list and replace fonts.

cmd:type.fitHeadline.label: Fit Headline
cmd:type.fitHeadline.params: {ids?} track the first line of area type so it fills the frame width → {ids, tracking}
cmd:type.fitHeadline.desc: Track the first line of area type so it fills the frame width.

cmd:type.hiddenCharacters.label: Show Hidden Characters
cmd:type.hiddenCharacters.params: {} toggle markers for spaces, paragraph ends and story ends
cmd:type.hiddenCharacters.desc: Toggle markers for spaces, paragraph ends and story ends.

cmd:type.insert.label: Insert Character
cmd:type.insert.params: {char: "bullet"|"copyright"|"ellipsis"|"paragraph"|"registered"|"section"|"trademark"|"emDash"|"enDash"|"discretionaryHyphen"|"nonBreakingHyphen"|"doubleLeftQuote"|"doubleRightQuote"|"singleLeftQuote"|"singleRightQuote"|"emSpace"|"enSpace"|"hairSpace"|"sixthSpace"|"thinSpace"|"nonBreakingSpace"|"figureSpace"|"punctuationSpace"|"thirdSpace"|"quarterSpace"|"tab"|"forcedLineBreak"|"paragraphReturn" | text: string} append to the selected text objects
cmd:type.insert.desc: Insert a special character such as a bullet, dash, quote or space.

cmd:type.pathOptions.label: Type on a Path Options…
cmd:type.pathOptions.params: {ids?, start?: 0..1, end?: 0..1|null, flip?: bool, effect?: rainbow|skew|3dRibbon|stairStep|gravity, alignToPath?: ascender|descender|center|baseline, spacing?: pt} set the selected type on a path's options: start and end place its start and end brackets as fractions of the path's length (end null: the end of the path, or once round a closed path), and flip then turns the type to the other side of its path (the path runs the other way, the brackets swap ends); none given: query → the first object's {start, end, flip: false, effect, alignToPath, spacing}
cmd:type.pathOptions.desc: Set how type sits on a path: effects, alignment, flip and spacing.

cmd:type.recentFont1.label: Recent Font 1
cmd:type.recentFont1.params: {} apply the 1. most recently used font
cmd:type.recentFont1.desc: Apply the most recently used font.

cmd:type.recentFont10.label: Recent Font 10
cmd:type.recentFont10.params: {} apply the 10. most recently used font
cmd:type.recentFont10.desc: Apply the tenth most recently used font.

cmd:type.recentFont2.label: Recent Font 2
cmd:type.recentFont2.params: {} apply the 2. most recently used font
cmd:type.recentFont2.desc: Apply the second most recently used font.

cmd:type.recentFont3.label: Recent Font 3
cmd:type.recentFont3.params: {} apply the 3. most recently used font
cmd:type.recentFont3.desc: Apply the third most recently used font.

cmd:type.recentFont4.label: Recent Font 4
cmd:type.recentFont4.params: {} apply the 4. most recently used font
cmd:type.recentFont4.desc: Apply the fourth most recently used font.

cmd:type.recentFont5.label: Recent Font 5
cmd:type.recentFont5.params: {} apply the 5. most recently used font
cmd:type.recentFont5.desc: Apply the fifth most recently used font.

cmd:type.recentFont6.label: Recent Font 6
cmd:type.recentFont6.params: {} apply the 6. most recently used font
cmd:type.recentFont6.desc: Apply the sixth most recently used font.

cmd:type.recentFont7.label: Recent Font 7
cmd:type.recentFont7.params: {} apply the 7. most recently used font
